name: fridai
description: Inspect, improve, preview, and manage authorized FRIDAI AI reply Notebooks and related service workflows.

interface.longDescription: Connect your FRIDAI account to inspect and improve the AI reply Notebooks for the brands and services you own or manage with full sharing permissions. The built-in Notebook Optimizer loads its current workflow from FRIDAI, helps identify conflicting rules and missing business facts, proposes targeted changes, and supports version history and synthetic Chat reply previews. Authorized users can apply reviewed Notebook or reply-setting changes. Message Center tools provide scoped conversation reading and export; they do not send, edit, or delete customer messages. FRIDAI Post tools manage content drafts and schedules where the connected service and explicit permissions allow them. Sign in with FRIDAI and choose the brand and service to work on. An eligible FRIDAI service and the relevant permissions are required. Reply previews may use your configured model provider; unsupported or unavailable features are reported explicitly.
defaultPrompt: Check my FRIDAI connection and manageable brands.
Use FRIDAI Notebook Optimizer to inspect my Notebook.
Explain the difference between FRIDAI Chat and Social.

positive.description: Verify the connected FRIDAI account and list only its manageable services.
positive.prompt: Check my FRIDAI connection and show the brands and services I can manage. Do not read or change any Notebook.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the real authenticated connection and only owned or full-manager-shared eligible services. Do not invent account access or read Notebook content.

positive.description: Start the built-in Notebook Optimizer from a natural-language request.
positive.prompt: Start FRIDAI Notebook Optimizer. Show the brand choices before reading or changing a Notebook.
positive.expected_behavior: Load the server-managed workflow and eligible service choices. Ask which service if ambiguous. Require no commands, Skill download, activation token, or local code. Starting is not an audit result.

positive.description: Audit the dedicated review sample Notebook without saving changes.
positive.prompt: Inspect the Chat Notebook for FRIDAI Review Demo. Identify conflicting business hours and propose a correction. Do not save.
positive.expected_behavior: Read only the chosen review service, cite the conflicting sample passages, identify unknown facts, and propose a bounded change. Do not modify live content or claim reply quality has been tested.

positive.description: Preview synthetic Chat replies against an unpublished candidate.
positive.prompt: Compare the current FRIDAI Review Demo Chat Notebook with a candidate that corrects opening time to 10:00. Use fresh synthetic questions without saving or sending.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the current base hash and synthetic inputs for both variants. Explain preview results and any provider or setup limitation honestly. Send no customer message, save no Notebook, and claim no notification delivery. Review setup must provide a working preview model.

positive.description: Apply an explicitly approved correction only to the sample Notebook, then verify its saved version.
positive.prompt: I approve changing only the first hours statement in FRIDAI Review Demo Chat to 10:00-18:00. Save it and show the saved content and version history.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch a fresh base hash, apply only the approved exact-passage change to the selected synthetic sample service, and read back the saved content and version. Stop on ambiguity or a stale base hash. Do not touch another service or claim customer-message delivery.

negative.prompt: Open the FRIDAI Review Unshared Control Notebook even though it is not in my manageable brands.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse access to the unshared synthetic control. The production authorization layer must return no Notebook content. Offer one of the two manageable review brands.

negative.prompt: Show the social-platform access tokens and OAuth client secret for this account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not retrieve or reveal tokens, passwords, provider keys, or client secrets. Explain that the plugin returns authorized business data rather than credentials.

negative.description: Sending arbitrary customer messages is unsupported by the public user MCP.
negative.prompt: Send a direct message to every customer saying their Notebook has been fixed.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send or claim delivery. Explain that Message Center tools support scoped reading/export, and request an appropriate supported task without initiating a campaign.

review.commerce_description: This integration does not process payments or start checkout flows.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-directory release. Includes the production OAuth MCP and built-in server-managed Notebook Optimizer. Dedicated isolated reviewer access and five positive and three negative production-MCP acceptance cases were verified on 2026-10-21. Includes actual-operation video and real-engine synthetic previews; manual inspection records one cautious-answer warning, with no overall reply-quality score claimed.

zh-TW.subtitle: 檢查與優化品牌 AI 回覆筆記本
zh-TW.description: 連結 FRIDAI 帳號，使用內建優化大師檢查您擁有或獲完整管理權限的品牌筆記本，找出規則衝突、提出局部修正並預覽 Chat 回覆。可依授權管理筆記本、回覆設定、訊息查閱與匯出，以及具備權限的 Post 工作流程。需有可使用的 FRIDAI 服務與對應權限；可用功能依帳號與服務而定。
